newsitem.title: USA: U.S. BRASS MILL SHIPMENTS UP 7.6 PCT ON YEAR- ABMS.
newsitem.headline: U.S. BRASS MILL SHIPMENTS UP 7.6 PCT ON YEAR- ABMS.

text.p: U.S. brass mill shipments for the first half of the year totaled 931,895 short tons, up 7.6 percent from last year's corresponding period, which totaled 866,280 tons, according to the American Bureau of Metal Statistics.
Inventories as of June 30 totaled 145,065 tons, up 0.8 percent from May 31, which totaled 143,798 tons. Inventories are down 2.7 percent from last June, when inventories totaled 149,071 tons.
